title: YOUHAN ONE agent execution session
description: Control artefact recording what one agent session was authorised to do. It is not a specification: it carries no requirements, no acceptance criteria, no approvals and no secrets. See docs/sdd/AGENT_SESSION_STANDARD.md.

schemaVersion.description: Supported session schema version. An unsupported value is SDD-V047.

sessionId.description: Must match the file name without the .json suffix. SDD-V047.

specId.description: The owning specification. Must match the directory the record lives under. SDD-V048.

role.description: One of the seven roles in docs/sdd/AGENT_ROLE_MODEL.md. SDD-V042.

actorType.description: Sessions are normally ai. A human session is recorded the same way.

actorId.description: Opaque label distinguishing one actor from another, used for separation of duty under SDD-V051. Never a credential, never a personal identifier beyond what the team already publishes.

taskIds.description: Tasks this session executes. Each must exist in tasks.md. SDD-V044.

startedFromCommit.description: The commit the session began from, for drift detection under SDD-V052.

initialChangedPaths.description: Working-tree paths already changed when the session started. Paired with initialDigests so pre-existing work is never attributed to the agent. A rename contributes both of its paths.

initialDigests.description: SHA-256 of each initially-changed path at session start, or null where the path did not exist or could not be read. Attribution compares these against the current content: a path that was already dirty and was then modified again by the session is still attributed to the session. A path present in initialChangedPaths with no entry here is UNATTRIBUTED and raises SDD-V052, never a silent pass.

allowedPaths.description: Derived from the task's declared scope. Exact paths and directory prefixes only, no globs and no regular expressions. SDD-V045, SDD-V046, SDD-V056.

prohibitedPaths.description: Paths this session must not modify even if they fall inside an allowed prefix. SDD-V058.

requiredTests.description: Test identifiers the task names. SDD-V057 refuses COMPLETE while any of these has no recorded verification.

verifiedTests.description: Required tests with a recorded verification result. Populated from VER-NNNN records, never asserted directly by the implementing agent.

requiredApprovals.description: Human approval kinds this session's risk level demands. Presence here is a reminder, not a grant. SDD-V020.

status.description: COMPLETE means the assigned execution scope was carried out. It does not mean verified and does not mean accepted.

result.description: Terminal outcome, null while the session is open.

notes.description: Unexpected findings, scope deviations and new unknowns. Never command output and never a credential. SEC-006.
